notes: Verified live 2026-10-07 in a plain headed Chrome from a residential connection, read only. The home page search box only takes one string and sends it as a first name, so the recipe builds the results URL /pub-multisearch.pubview?searchFirstName=&searchLastName=&searchLocation= directly. John Smith in Houston, TX lists 100 results as li.ais-InfiniteHits-item cards: a.hit-name ("john r smith, 77", linking to /site/ob/init/ps-bgc.pubview?epid=<id>, which is the stable record link), .hit-location, and Places Lived values. The two buttons on a card go to the same epid. A search with nothing found shows "We didn't find" and no cards. The results answer with a Cloudflare check first (403 on the first hop) that cleared by itself in a plain Chrome, but a Playwright launched Chrome stayed on "Just a moment" and a run there ends as bot_detection. The privacy request page shows a reCAPTCHA, so the remove recipe cannot be completed without a person. The old version guessed a /first-last/ URL and generic selectors.
